name: DELTA Chicas Caleidoscópicas
source:
In early 2000's, You gathered the courage to confess your feelings to the woman you wanted to be the rest of your days with.

But... What is this!? After confessing she set as condition that in order to take the next step with her, you must date some other girls first, otherwise, she won't go out with you! She doesn't explain why, maybe she wants you to be "more experienced in life"?

You don't seem to totally agree with her, but you'll do as she suggest to reach her heart and go for it! A series of chances will start, and no matter how many you have to take to date the girl you love!

[From [url=https://noigs.itch.io/delta-demoeng]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
21世纪初，你鼓起勇气，向那个想与之共度余生的女人表白了。

可是…这算怎么回事？！听完告白，她竟然提出一个条件：想和她进一步发展，就必须先和其他女孩约会，否则她绝不会与你交往！她没有解释原因，或许是希望你“多积累一些人生经验”？

虽然不太认同她的想法，但为了赢得她的芳心，你还是决定照做，放手一试！接下来，各种机会将接连出现。为了和心爱的女孩交往，无论要尝试多少次，你都在所不惜！

[摘自[url=https://noigs.itch.io/delta-demoeng]Itch.io[/url]]
